papers.title: Letter to the Pump Room
lines: Dear Sirs, I took the waters faithfully for a fortnight as advised.
I am now wonderfully regular, and quite alarmingly cheerful.
I enclose a cheque and a request for a bigger bottle.

papers.title: Miner's note
lines: Found a vein of the purple stuff behind the old timbers.
Told nobody but the dog. The dog has told nobody either, but he looks smug.
I have marked the place with a pit prop and a pile of three stones.

trail.clue: A miner's pile of stones near the big rock. Dig where three stones once sat together.

papers.title: Fell race entry form
lines: Name: Gwen. Club: none, I run alone. Experience: I once chased a bus up Axe Edge.
Next of kin: the bus driver.
Estimated finish: before the pub shuts.

papers.title: Well-dressing card
lines: This year's picture is to be done in petals, seeds and moss. No glitter. Not again, Marjorie.
Clay is ready in the shed. Bring a bucket, a sharp knife and a kind word.

papers.title: Trial scorecard
lines: Fly, the collie. Outrun: good. Lift: good. Fetch: sat down and looked at the judge.
Drive: good. Pen: she shut the gate and then the judge in.
Total: 71 out of 100. Judge's comment: 'I admire her.'
